elena.voice_description: A woman in her late twenties with a low, warm, intimate voice, slightly breathless, soft and close to the microphone, neutral American accent, quiet intensity, dark romance audiobook narrator, clean studio recording.
elena.text: The book had my name in it. Written three hundred years before I was born. And the date I die is tonight. Who are you? Then why do I know your voice?

lucien.voice_description: A man in his thirties with a deep, calm, quiet voice, old-world and refined, subtle Received Pronunciation British accent, unhurried, never raises his voice, velvety low register, intimate and melancholic, clean studio recording.
lucien.text: You weren't supposed to find that. The man who wrote it. It says you die tonight, every time. Three hundred years, Elena. And you never remember me.
